<!--DESCRIPTION
|   Reference page for PuTTY color configuration.
|____________________________________________________________________-->

Learn how to customize your terminal's appearance by modifying the PuTTY configuration color values.

## Export Default Configuration File

Follow [these instructions](../environment-setup__reference/putty.html#access-saved-session-configurations) to export your PuTTY configuration file.

## Color Labels

In the `.reg` file of a saved session configuration, the colors can be found in the section of text where lines are in the following format:

`"Colour#"="#,#,#"`.

Note that `#` of `Colour#` does *not* correspond with normal ANSI colors, i.e. 0 = black, 1 = red, etc. The meaning of the color labels are listed in the table below.

Label | Color
-|-
`Colour0`  | Foreground
`Colour1`  | Bright Foreground
`Colour2`  | Background
`Colour3`  | Bright Background
`Colour4`  | Cursor Foreground
`Colour5`  | Cursor Background
`Colour6`  | Black
`Colour7`  | Bright Black
`Colour8`  | Red
`Colour9`  | Bright Red
`Colour10` | Green
`Colour11` | Bright Green
`Colour12` | Yellow
`Colour13` | Bright Yellow
`Colour14` | Blue
`Colour15` | Bright Blue
`Colour16` | Magenta
`Colour17` | Bright Magenta
`Colour18` | Cyan
`Colour19` | Bright Cyan
`Colour20` | White
`Colour21` | Bright White

### Sample Color Theme Section

__Note:__ Whitespace is permitted in the configuration file.

```
"Colour0" ="187, 187, 187"
"Colour1" ="255, 255, 255"
"Colour2" =" 28,  28,  28"
"Colour3" =" 95,  95,  95"
"Colour4" =" 12,  12,  12"
"Colour5" ="255, 135,  95"
"Colour6" =" 18,  18,  18"
"Colour7" =" 48,  48,  48"
"Colour8" ="215,  95, 135"
"Colour9" ="255,  95, 135"
"Colour10"="135, 215,  95"
"Colour11"="135, 255,  95"
"Colour12"="255, 135,  95"
"Colour13"="215, 215,  95"
"Colour14"=" 95, 135, 215"
"Colour15"=" 95, 135, 255"
"Colour16"="175,  95, 215"
"Colour17"="175,  95, 255"
"Colour18"=" 95, 175, 215"
"Colour19"=" 95, 175, 255"
"Colour20"="215, 215, 215"
"Colour21"="255, 255, 255"
```

## Import Configuration File

Follow [these instructions](../environment-setup__reference/putty.html#import-configuration) to import your modified PuTTY configuration file.
